name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia 2
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティア2
source:
After defeating Jinevra, Souma and Marina lived the normal life, until, one day, monsters from another world invaded again with a new main antagonist - Garzom. Moreover, Riesz, a knight from another world and a new harem candidate for Souma, appears too.

This ExS-Tia 2 comes with new battle system and new types of corruption. Let's see whether you can achieve the ending you want  and will Marina get jealous of the new harem member?
translation:
击败吉内芙拉后，苏玛和玛丽娜过着正常的生活，直到有一天，来自另一个世界的怪物再次入侵，并带来了新的主要对手 - 加尔佐姆。此外，来自异世界的骑士、素马的新后宫候选者里斯也出现了。

这款ExS-Tia 2配备了新的战斗系统和新的腐败类型。看看你能否达到你想要的结局，玛丽娜会嫉妒新的后宫成员吗？
